notes.title: Patches and Guides - some things that should have been here earlier
notes.content:
Hiya everyone,

First of all, I would like to thank everyone who downloaded the game and left feedack - constructive or otherwise - it means a lot to me.

Secondly, I'd like to share some of the things that I have changed in the meantime, hopefully these things help out a little:

Patch notes: 
added a fix for resolutions under 1080p - the game will still be somewhat blurry as it is being downscaled, but it should be readable up to 720p. 
Added a hint for the login - this seems to be quite contentious, but a hint should help regardless. 
Fixed a few crash bugs.

Lastly, our official guide for the game will be released soon, so that should help alleviate some of the more difficult puzzles and allow you to properly enjoy the story.

I'd like to conclude one more time by saying thank you for your feedback, and I'll continue making choices that improve the gaming experience.

- J. Zhang
